title: Top navigation controls
description: Exercise the workspace power and consolidated actions menus across desktop, tablet, and phone layouts.

steps.expected: New workspace and Edit workspace appear first; Logs, Upload file, and Automations follow the first divider; Manage Pi Auth, generic environment keys, MCP servers, Google Workspace, and Workspace request access follow the second divider; Delete workspace is the final separated destructive item. Items unavailable in the current workspace state are disabled rather than omitted.
The first available item receives focus. Arrow Down/Up and Home/End move among enabled menu items. Escape closes the menu and returns focus to More workspace actions.

At each viewport, workspace selection and both menu triggers remain visible with at least 44x44 touch targets, long workspace names stay clipped within the selector, no page-level horizontal overflow occurs, and the phone topbar uses two rows without the live meters.

Open Workspace power controls. A stopped workspace offers Start and disables Restart when no canonical runtime exists; a running workspace offers Stop and Restart. The menu supports arrow keys and Escape focus return.
